title: BPW-2026-0534
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0534
CD 3
TREE REMOVAL – 23200 WEST MULHOLLAND DRIVE
Recommending the Board:
FIND under the California Public Resources Code, Section 21166 and the State’s Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Section 15162, on the basis of substantial evidence contained in the whole record, that since the City’s prior certification of Environmental Impact Report (EIR) No. ENV-391-1984-CUZ there have been no changes to the project, changes with respect to the circumstances under which the project is being undertaken, or new information of substantial importance concerning the project, which cause new significant environmental effects or a substantial increase in the severity of previously identified significant effects, and therefore no subsequent EIR, supplemental EIR, or other analysis is required for the project;
SPECIFY that the Bureau of Street Services, Urban Forestry Division, located at 1149 South Broadway, is custodian of the documents or other material that constitute the record of proceedings upon which the Board’s decision is based;
CONCUR with the Bureau of Street Services determination that the site cannot feasibly accommodate all the required replacement street trees and pursuant to LAMC 62.177(c), authorize the Tree Replacement Guarantee fee to satisfy the Board’s tree planting requirement; and
REVIEW and APPROVE the request for a fee permit to remove twelve native protected trees and shrubs, and seven street trees in relation to Planning Case No. CPC-2001-5976-CU-ZV-ZAD-SPR. Tree replacements are required.
